description: Showed the loaf against the notch and kept the crusts off his side.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Set the soft side toward him, stated the threepence and the sixpence, and refused the latch.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Spoke once of a silk thread and a light, and left the table to the paper.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Took the soft side, asked for a length of red, and promised the three lines before another correction.
name: William Shakespeare
